name: Ichinen Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Ichinen Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the automotive leasing, chemical, parking, machine tool, synthetic resin, and agriculture businesses in Japan. The company is involved in automobile leasing, fuel sale, and automotive maintenance and outsourcing services; manufacturing of professional-use, techno, fine, and consumer chemical products; and operation of parking lots and plots for supermarkets and hospitals, parking garages affiliated with tenant buildings, and idle lands.
